result.summary: Mehtab Agro Foods currently has two open overdue notifications totaling INR 6.0m across both policies (TCI-SCF-2026-0001 at 64 DPD and TCI-WT-2026-0002 at 41 DPD), compared to a single resolved case five months ago that was only 18 days late. Notification frequency has doubled in the last 6-month window (2 vs 1 prior) and now spans both policies simultaneously, indicating broadening payment stress rather than an isolated delay. Given utilization against the INR 15m and 8m credit limits remains moderate, limits need not be cut yet, but tightening monitoring and following up on collection of the 61-90 day invoice is advised.
concerns: Oldest open overdue has reached 61-90 days past due (64 DPD), more than 3x longer than the last resolved case (18 days late)
Notifications are now arriving from both policies (SCF and WT) within the same 6-month window, up from just one policy previously
Accumulation metric shows notification count doubling period-over-period, suggesting emerging liquidity strain
